evals.prompt: I have an existing Rust CLI with Cargo.toml, edition 2021 and rust-version 1.70. Where should I put a testable helper? The lockfile resolves a dependency to 1.43 but the manifest allows 1.x. Planning only; do not edit or build.
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes existing layout, lockfile, manifest range and MSRV; recommends a location from precedent and states verification limits.

evals.prompt: I have this existing Cargo.toml and src/main.rs. Planning only: where should a testable helper go, and what must be checked for edition, MSRV and dependency range? Do not edit or build.
evals.expected_output: Read-only project orientation and a bounded proposed layout.

evals.prompt: format-core has valid json and yaml features but compile_error! when both are enabled. report-json enables json with default-features = false, report-yaml enables yaml the same way. A top-level app depends on both crates. Planning only, do not edit or build: explain the collision and the smallest compatibility-aware fix, and how lockfile, MSRV and ranges relate.
evals.expected_output: Feature union across one graph defeats per-consumer exclusion; recommend genuinely additive backends or distinct package identities rather than adapter wrappers or a workspace redesign; lockfile, manifest ranges and MSRV remain separate checks; no build claimed.

evals.prompt: Explain why this Rust function returns an Option. Do not discuss project layout, Cargo, workspaces, or dependencies.
evals.expected_output: This is an explanation request, not a project-structure request.
